scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build --prefix client -- --mode desktop && cd desktop && npm install && npm run dist:win
scripts.desktop:start: npm run build --prefix client -- --mode desktop && cd desktop && npm install && npm start
